title: chat-filenode rights: align with spec ebdf95e
description: jmap-chat-spec ebdf95e rewrote draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 #permissions for filenode-19. crate-jmap-chat-filenode-server/src/lib.rs space_files_rights (~600-623) and its doc table (~540-556) implement the OLD table: mayModifyContent false on Directories and the root; root mayDelete/mayRename need manage_space (tier 4). New spec: rights are reported in myRights of every Directory incl. the root; a File/SymLink takes its parent Directory's rights; manage_channels OR manage_space get mayDelete, mayRename, mayModifyContent (no root exception); nobody may destroy, rename or move the root via FileNode/set (forbidden, role Directory); root removed only with its Space. Creating the root still needs manage_space. check_space_destroy and the update gate (~717) must follow. Depends on the base filenode crates' rights model (they implement -16; see the -16->-19 gap bead).
